**Black Condor II (Ryan Kendall) died in *Infinite Crisis* #1, cover-dated December 2005.**

I ran the searches and page reads myself rather than spawning the skill's research subagents. This is a single factual question with a small retrieval cap. I used three retrievals in total.

Claims and sources:

- Ryan Kendall, the second Black Condor, was killed in *Infinite Crisis* #1 (December 2005).
  - https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Ryan_Kendall_(New_Earth) (seen only as a search-result summary, because the page fetch failed with HTTP 402)
  - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor

- He died while with the Freedom Fighters, who were ambushed by the Secret Society of Super Villains.
  - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor
  - https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Ryan_Kendall_(New_Earth)

- Sinestro is credited with killing him, with a blast through the chest.
  - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor
  - https://comicvine.gamespot.com/ryan-kendall/4005-76170/ (search-result summary only)

- Nothing I found ties his death to *Final Crisis*.
  - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Final_Crisis (appeared only in the search results)

**Caveats:**
- I read the Wikipedia page only up to character 100,000 of about 111,800.
- The DC Fandom page and the Comic Vine page were not opened. For those two, I relied on the search tool's summary of them.
- One search summary mentioned Deathstroke as a killer for a different Freedom Fighter in the same issue. I didn't check that, and it doesn't affect the answer.
